operational_goals.title: Complete device inventory
operational_goals.description: Enumerate and register all physical and virtual machines in the space. Every device must have a complete entry in device-registry.json including IP, MAC, OS, role, and installed services.
operational_goals.success_criteria: All devices visible via 'navig skill run network-scan', all registered in device-registry.json, all reachable via ssh-connect or WOL.

operational_goals.title: Establish automated morning sweep
operational_goals.description: Configure the morning-sweep workflow to run automatically at 06:00 daily on the primary host. Results should be written to the wiki as a dated entry.
operational_goals.success_criteria: Workflow runs on schedule, produces a readable summary, anomalies surface as entries in known-issues.json.

operational_goals.title: Document all physical cable runs
operational_goals.description: Use cable-trace skill to document every physical network cable, KVM cable, USB hub connection, and power line in the homelab. Maintain cable-log.md in the wiki.
operational_goals.success_criteria: cable-log.md fully populated. Any cable can be identified by port, length, purpose, and destination. No undocumented cables.

operational_goals.title: Configure automated config sync
operational_goals.description: Establish sync-configs workflow between primary-desktop and all secondary machines. Dotfiles, shell configs, editor configs, and SSH keys should propagate automatically on change.
operational_goals.success_criteria: nightly-sync workflow runs without errors. New machines can be bootstrapped in under 5 minutes using sync-configs.

operational_goals.title: Track disk health across all hosts
operational_goals.description: Run the disk-health skill on every registered host weekly and record warnings (wear, temperature, unsafe shutdowns) in known-issues.json.
operational_goals.success_criteria: Every host has a disk-health result less than 7 days old; any warning has a known-issues entry.
